Remark
1. 3.2.8\group maximum-principle Source: topping:page-0048 If the Ricci flow exists for all $t\in [0,\infty )$, then \[ \overline V:=\lim _{t\to \infty }\frac{V(t)}{\left(1+\frac{2(-\alpha )}{n}t\right)^{\frac n2}} \] exists. A rough principle in Perelman's work is that, locally, $\overline V>0$ suggests the manifold is becoming hyperbolic, while $\overline V=0$ suggests a graph-manifold-like limit.
